experiment: Silesia final balanced original-v9 versus frozen forward-trie v4
aggregation: Sum the twelve file times in each repetition, then take the median over four repetitions; maximum per-process RSS is reported separately.
limitations: Silesia was used in development; it is not held-out evidence.
Frozen v4 is an experimental build with changed restart semantics; it is not the v12 integration binary.
The private v12 integration independently matches every frozen-v4 payload after accounting only for container version and header CRC; this is identity, not a fresh timing run.
This comparison measures the complete context-tree, storage and coder-call redesign, not isolated hash cost.
Per-start filtered process snapshots are not continuous core-occupancy monitoring.
Build sidecars describe earlier builds after the run, not a contemporaneous build execution log.
Automatic model restart policies differ between v9 and v4.
